Order.title: Order
Order.description: A student campus delivery order placed on CampusKart.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the student who placed the order

items.description: List of ordered products and quantities

subtotal.description: Sum of item prices before delivery fee

time.description: Server timestamp when the order was created

createdAtMs.description: Client epoch timestamp in milliseconds for immediate sorting

/orders/{orderId}.description: CampusKart customer orders, readable and creatable only by the owning authenticated user.
